item.title: A fairer before and after on your board
item.summary: Your 1v1 board now compares this week with the 60 days before your first game, so your change can show up by about Day 5.
item.details: Days when a device sent no steps no longer count, so a gap can't look like a big jump or win a crown. Heart rate, sleep, steps and VO2 max now share up to 180 days.
